# TB2J 0.9.20 source reference

Read-only reference for the TB2J command interface. This bundle is not installed.
The `wann2J.py` command entry point maps to `TB2J.scripts.wann2J:run_wann2J`;
see `TB2J.egg-info/entry_points.txt`. Read `TB2J/scripts/wann2J.py` for argument
parsing and `TB2J/exchange_params.py` for shared parameter definitions. Follow
imports into the retained package when needed. Task prompts determine whether
execution is allowed.

All Python source files under `TB2J/`, the upstream license, package metadata
and build configuration are copied unchanged from the official PyPI source
archive. Separate documentation, images, CI files and files outside that scope
are omitted. `PROVENANCE.json` records the archive URL, SHA-256, every retained
file hash and every omitted file. No benchmark solutions or paper files are added.

License: BSD-2-Clause. Retain `LICENSE` and the original copyright notices.
